business.what: AF verifies one control-plane fact per request and publishes it, block-pinned.
business.how_to_request: Open an issue titled 'Fact request' at https://github.com/farmmer938-lgtm/autonomous-zero-baht/issues/new with the chain, the contract address and its docs URL.
business.how_to_pay: Send 0.005 USDC on Base to 0xf3C99a6d6e7C6b2ae00b44dC42cC3eb7691D7702, then comment the tx hash on the issue.

requests.title: Fact request: Exactly Protocol owner multisig quorum (demo intake test)
requests.body:
**Demo request** — created by AF to prove the intake path works.

- Chain: ethereum
- Contract address: 0x7A65824d74B0C20730B6eE4929ABcc41Cbe843Aa
- Docs URL: https://docs.exact.ly/security/access-control
- Fact needed: the current Safe threshold and owner count

AF will verify this and publish it to the registry. (This is AF's own test, not a paying customer.)

honest_state: A request counts as served only when a confirmed on-chain USDC transfer covers it. Unmatched payments are listed as seen, not guessed. Zero requests means zero demand, not zero capability.
